name: Bridgmanite
notes: Ambient lattice: Vanpeteghem et al., Geophysical Research Letters 33, L03306 (2006), doi:10.1029/2005GL024955. Ambient fractional coordinates: Yagi et al., Physics and Chemistry of Minerals 3, 97-110 (1978), doi:10.1007/BF00308114, COD 9005757. The default mantle-range EoS is from Tange et al. (2012); the Vanpeteghem BM2 fit is retained as a low-pressure alternative. Phase-line intensities were calculated from the cited structure using independent-atom X-ray form factors.

eos_records.label: Tange et al. (2012), mantle-range BM3-MGD

reference.source: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth

eos_records.notes: Preferred default for mantle work. The fit combines multi-anvil data at 28-63 GPa and 300-1500 K with laser-heated DAC data at 52-108 GPa and 300 or 1500-2430 K; the study reports measurements up to 110 GPa and 2500 K. V0=162.373 A^3 was fixed to an independent ambient measurement; theta0=950(150) K, gamma0=1.54(9), and q=1.5(3). The paper calls the exponent b; with its fixed a=1, the published Gruneisen expression reduces exactly to gamma=gamma0(V/V0)^b used here.

eos_records.label: Tange et al. (2012), mantle-range Vinet-MGD

reference.source: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth

eos_records.notes: Alternative Vinet fit to the same multi-anvil and laser-heated DAC dataset, measured up to 110 GPa and 2500 K. V0=162.373 A^3 was fixed to an independent ambient measurement; theta0=940(140) K, gamma0=1.55(9), and q=1.1(3). The paper calls the exponent b; with a fixed to 1, it is the q parameter of the conventional MGD volume dependence stored here.

eos_records.label: Vanpeteghem et al. (2006), low-pressure single-crystal BM2
eos_records.notes: Single-crystal P-V data to 10 GPa. Retained as a low-pressure structural reference, not as the default mantle-range EoS. The normalized-stress plot supported a second-order Birch-Murnaghan fit, so K0_prime=4 is implicit in BM2 rather than stored as a fitted parameter.
